# v0.1.21 preview

This artifact is a preview. It is not a claim of GitHub Actions
equivalence.

The version string is 0.1.21. The capability version is 12.

`submissions migrate` previews or applies one bounded batch of legacy
snapshot reporting state. Terminal runs whose snapshots are gone get a
durable disposition and a tombstone, and active or still-reportable runs
are kept. The first poll also runs it.

The wheel and the source tarball can be built from this tree. They
are not published. This change does not create a tag.

The project license is the MIT License.

The App private key is not in the artifact.
